# Verdict: **KEEP** the remedy below: a local stat/profile correction plus prose The current calf inverts the frozen arithmetic, *"the small are cheap, the parents are catastrophic"*: - **Contact damage.** Its permanent juvenile stage has a nominal tail sweep of 360. That is 16× the mother's 22 bite and 9× a 40-hp body-part budget. - **Health.** Its HealthScale of 12 exceeds the mother's 7. - **Armor.** It inherits the adult's 0.70 sharp crust, which contradicts its own description (*"the reef has barely begun to grow on it"*) and the Grey Deep sheet (the crust comes from *"centuries"*). A damage reduction is warranted, not assumed. The one-field alternative (`manhunterOnDamageChance` 0) would leave a 360-tail, HS-12 animal that any other animal-insanity or self-defence path still releases. It would also drop the ill-tempered lineage and leave the health inversion in place. Nothing changes on the adult or the mother. ## 1. Roles | Role | Def | Combat role | |---|---|---| | **Nursery prey** | `RM_ReefbackJuv` | Thin crust, light hits, cheap at range. If it turns on a hunter it costs a wound, not a life. Large only by any measure other than its own kind's (16 vs the adult's 32). Its danger is *where* it lives, not what it is. | | **Open-sea giant** | `RM_Reefback` | Crusted, enormous health budget, kills with one tail sweep. Catastrophic. | | **Crèche guard** | `RM_WardenMother` | Lethal within reach through rapid bites. Water-locked and anchored (radius 16). Its tankiness sits between calf and adult. | ## 2. Exact changes, all local to the young reefback `TerminalBiomes/Defs/ThingDefs_Races/RM_SeaBeasts_Invented.xml`, `RM_ReefbackJuv` ThingDef: ```xml A reefback hatchling-sized by comparison only: the reef has barely begun to grow on it, its crust is still thin enough to cut, and it drifts close to wherever the adults went. 0.25 0.30 0.30
  • Blunt
    • 16 3.0 HeadAttackTool
  • Blunt
    • 10 2.5 FrontLeftPaw 0.3     8 ``` `RM_ReefbackJuv` PawnKindDef: add `150`. It currently inherits 2000, above the mother's 1400. The value is provisional profile metadata; the A2 consumer check decides whether anything reads it. Kept as is: - `manhunterOnDamageChance` 0.2, inherited; this is the ill-tempered lineage in miniature. - Body sizes 6.4/16, the two stages, wildGroupSize 2~3, ecoSystemWeight 4.0, MarketValue, art and drawSizes. - Miasma weight 0.15 and every adult and mother. ## 3. Effective stage values | Stage | BodySize | HealthScale | Tool powers, effective | Sharp / Blunt / Heat armor | MoveSpeed (water ×) | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | Young baby, 0–0.1 y | 6.4 | 2.0 | tail 8, bulk 5 | 0.30 / 0.25 / 0.30 | 1.0 (×2) | | Young juvenile, 0.1 y onward, **permanent** | 16 | 4.8 | tail 12, bulk 7.5 | same | 1.8 (×2) | | *(was: juvenile)* | 16 | 12 | tail 360, bulk 90 | 0.70 / 0.60 / 0.75 | — | | Adult reefback | 32 | 20 | 480 / 120 | 0.70 / 0.60 / 0.75 | 2.0 (×2) | | Mother, adult or elder | 8 | 7 | bite 22, slam 18 | 0.65 / 0.55 / 0 | 1.6 (×1.8) | | Mother baby / juvenile (control) | 1.6 / 4 | 1.75 / 4.2 | 11, 9 / 16.5, 13.5 | same | — | ## 4. Worked hunting comparison (frozen model) Model inputs: residual armor r = max(armor − 0.15, 0); remaining fraction = 1 − 0.75r; team DPS = 4.8 × remaining fraction. The budget is ceil(40 × HS) / DPS. It is a body-part damage-budget comparison, **not** time to kill or down. | Target | r | Remaining | Damage per landed hit | Team DPS | Budget | Budget time | Share of budget spent in 30 s | |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---| | Young baby | 0.15 | 0.8875 | 10.65 | 4.26 | 80 | 18.8 s | >100% | | **Young juvenile** | 0.15 | 0.8875 | 10.65 | 4.26 | 192* | **45.1 s** | 67% | | *(current juvenile)* | 0.55 | 0.5875 | 7.05 | 2.82 | 480* | 170.2 s | 18% | | Mother | 0.50 | 0.625 | 7.50 | 3.00 | 280 | 93.3 s | 32% | | Adult | 0.55 | 0.5875 | 7.05 | 2.82 | 800 | 283.7 s | 11% | \* Float32 caveat: 0.6f × 8 × 40 lands exactly on half a unit in the last place. The validator must use the production path and accept 192 or 193 (current juvenile: 480 or 481). The difference is immaterial. **Contact and retaliation limits**, nominal upper bounds that ignore miss, tool choice and armor: | Attacker | Power per hit | Hits ≈ in 30 s | Nominal damage in 30 s | |---|---|---|---| | Young juvenile tail | 12 (0.3× a 40-hp part) | 10 | ~120 (wounding) | | Mother bite | 22 | 15 | ~330 (lethal) | | Adult tail | 480 | ~3.5 | far beyond a 40-hp part (lethal per hit) | **Manhunter chance**, illustrating 0.2 per damaging hit (production applies its own factors): - Proposed juvenile: about 5.6 damaging hits in 30 s, so roughly a 71% chance it turns. It is now more likely to turn, but it turns cheaply. - Current juvenile: about 4.4 hits, roughly 62%, and lethal when it does. **Does the model support the nursery wording?** Yes, as relative arithmetic. Compared with the mother and the adult, the juvenile has: - about half the mother's budget and one sixth of the adult's; - about half the mother's per-hit damage and 1/40 of the adult's. That is "cheap" without being trivial: a size-16 animal still takes most of a 30-second volley. Going softer is not warranted. ## 5. Prose correction Put this in `REEFBACK_CALF_DECISION.md` and the item spec. The frozen Miasma sheet itself is not edited. > *Young reefback: nursery prey. Thin-crusted and light-hitting, cheap for two modest shooters at range; if it turns, it wounds rather than kills. Large by every measure but its kind's. Its danger is its mother's reach (anchor guard, radius 16), not itself. No mechanism makes killing a calf provoke a mother beyond her existing reach and target rules, and none is claimed.* Also replace the spec's "inherits 480/120, tail sweeps 240/360" with the values in §3. ## 6. Constraint incompatibilities (recorded, not resolved) - **"Small" vs body size.** The juvenile's size 16 exceeds the mother's 8. Sizes are preserved by ruling, so "small" is carried by combat role, by comparison with the adult (16 vs 32), and by drawSize (4.42 vs the mother's 7.5). Draw size is a value only; no render was observed. - **Mother's lineage.** The prose calls her "enormous" and of "centuries", but she is size 8 with lifeExpectancy 45 and an elder stage at 38. She is not a child of `RM_Reefback`. This is out of scope. - **Stale roster note.** `rosters/the_miasma.json` still says "placed set-piece, NEVER wildAnimals". The 2026-09-23 amendment supersedes it. Flag it; don't change it here. - **Density.** 6.5 is not comparable with weight 4 or group 2–3. No population claim is made. ## 7. Missed cases and negative controls (BROADEN) 1. **Tools append vs replace.** Plain `` would yield four tools (480, 120, 16, 10). Assert exactly two resolved tools, 16 and 10, with unique labels. 2. **statBases merge.** Assert that MoveSpeed 2.0, MarketValue 8000, comfy temperatures and Wildness 1.0 are still inherited. An accidental `Inherit="False"` would drop them. 3. **Missing overrides.** Remove `baseHealthScale`: the control must resolve to 20 and fail. Same for armor (expect 0.70) and combatPower (expect 2000). 4. **Stage factors from installed Core.** Read AnimalBaby (0.25, 0.5) and AnimalJuvenile (0.6, 0.75) from installed Core, not hardcoded values. Scan the load order for patches that touch these LifeStageDefs. 5. **Juvenile held indefinitely.** Ages 0.6, 50 and 499 must all stay AnimalJuvenile with HS 4.8 and tail 12. Assert that no AnimalAdult stage is reachable. 6. **Broken parent lookup.** If ParentName fails to resolve, the def loses its body. Assert the resolved values: Pinniped body, Leather_Sealskin, waterSeeker, `canBePredatorPrey` false, `disableMating`, kind water factor 2.0. Assert that HeadAttackTool and FrontLeftPaw exist on Pinniped. 7. **Adult controls.** `RM_Reefback` is byte-identical in effect: 480/120, HS 20, 0.70/0.60/0.75, size 32, combatPower 2000. 8. **Mother controls.** 22/18, HS 7, size 8, 0.65/0.55, combatPower 1400. The elder stage resolves health and melee factors to 1 (constructor defaults). Anchor and water-locked comps are intact. 9. **Patches.** XPath patches run before inheritance. Check that no patch targets `RM_Reefback/tools` or `RM_ReefbackJuv`, and that no patch reaches the juvenile past `Inherit="False"`. 10. **Other children.** Check every other `ParentName="RM_Reefback"` def across mods; none may change. 11. **Translations.** A `DefInjected` description for `RM_ReefbackJuv` would mask the new English text. Check for one. 12. **Rosters.** The Miasma 0.15 row and the Grey Sea row are unchanged. `ecoSystemWeight` 4.0 and wildGroupSize 2~3 are unchanged. 13. **combatPower consumers.** List the production readers of the juvenile kind's combatPower. If none applies, record that the change is metadata only. 14. **Outside the model, stated not tested.** Bleed-out scales with body size, so a size-16 calf bleeds out slowly. The model also excludes herd revenge across a group of 2–3, water-cell pathing and fleeing at 3.6, melee-only hunters, and pain. ## Not claimed No actual hits, downing or kill times, population outcomes, render, or L4 feel. The live validation for this stat-only change remains ordinary owner play under CHARTER.
